# Automuk

> Automuk is a full-service digital studio that builds AI solutions, websites, custom dashboards, branding, and workflow automation for modern businesses.

## About

Automuk helps businesses gain an unfair competitive advantage by combining intelligent AI systems with beautiful digital products. We operate as a lean, high-output studio serving founders, startups, and growing businesses worldwide.

Contact: arijit@autom.uk
Website: https://autom.uk
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/automuk

## Services

### AI Solutions
Custom-built AI agents, LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, and intelligent chatbots that operate 24/7. We work with GPT-4o, Claude, Llama, and vector database infrastructure to build autonomous systems that reduce human overhead and handle complex tasks at scale.

### Web Development
Single-page and multi-page high-performance websites built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript. Every site is optimised for Core Web Vitals, SEO, accessibility, and conversions — from landing pages to full marketing portals.

### Custom Dashboards
Tailored operational dashboards, admin panels, and internal tools built to your exact business logic and data sources. Real-time analytics, role-based access, and scalable architecture.

### Branding & Marketing
End-to-end brand identity design and digital marketing strategy — logo systems, visual language, SEO, paid advertising, and content campaigns.

### Workflow Automation
Industrial-grade workflow orchestration using Zapier, Make (Integromat), and n8n. We connect your entire tech stack to eliminate manual work and ensure 100% data accuracy.

## Engagement Models

- **Strategic Consultancy** — 1-on-1 advisory sessions for strategy, architecture, and roadblock resolution. Direct founder access.
- **End-to-End Delivery** — Full-cycle project execution from discovery to production deployment. Complete ownership handover.
- **Managed Ecosystem** — Ongoing subscription retainer with 24/7 priority support, monthly feature sprints, and infrastructure maintenance.

## Selected Work

- **Westra** (westra.in) — Premium women's fashion eCommerce with live Facebook selling integration
- **Animhaus** (animhaus.com) — Cinematic website for an animation and visual engineering studio
- **Grabfabs** (grabfabs.com) — B2B wholesale marketplace with AI-powered product tagging (60% faster listing)
- **Awakynn** (awakynn.com) — Wellness platform for holistic health and Ayurvedic consultations
- **Shurerdhara** (shurerdhara.com) — Cultural heritage platform for Padma Shri awardee Rezwana Choudhury Bannya
- **KDIAE** (kdiae.in) — School management system with admissions, attendance, fee, and reporting modules
- **Zorg Social** (zorgsocial.com) — AI-powered SaaS platform for multi-platform social media management
- **Quplast** (quplast.com) — eCommerce platform for household and packaging goods supplier

## Tech Stack
